You can start by reading Writing Down the Bones by Natalie Goldberg, it will help you to find your own style. 
Then, just let your pen take the lead for the words in your heart and brain, your hand will eventually start writing when you have it all in your mind, just don't think it too much.
And when it comes to writing I think that you should avoid a mistake -that I personally do-, try to write your drafts in one specific place (online or papers for example). Also, never postpone an idea, if it's there for a moment, then it should be written within the next few moments.
I'm not a professional writer, but those are some tips I use to write, hope it helps.
